Huy together with Nguyen supplies the affirmative Vietnamese given-name signal. Ran find-roster-matches with his name and supplied identity URLs: fourteen name-only hits, no URL matches. Inspected all fourteen records; their disciplines and degree histories differ, including vp-3190, a Dartmouth-PhD spatial-genomics researcher rather than this Harvard/Toronto master's-trained computational biologist. Not listed in already-proposed.txt. Current Boston appointment is outside Vietnam.
